subject.title: feat(talk): expose gateway audio to plugins

question: What plugin trust and session-capability contract should authorize access to Gateway-owned Talk PCM before this public runtime API is introduced?
rationale: The code cannot safely choose whether all installed plugins may observe any voice session, whether consent must be per plugin/session, or how permission should be represented in the plugin contract.

options.title: Add a scoped Talk-media capability
options.body: Require an explicit manifest/runtime capability and enforce session ownership or a user-approved session grant before delivering PCM to a plugin.

options.title: Approve global plugin observation
options.body: Document that any loaded plugin may subscribe to all Gateway Talk output and accept that voice-media exposure as the plugin trust model.

options.title: Pause the public API
options.body: Keep the internal media work out of the plugin SDK until maintainers settle a reusable permission model.

recommendation.title: Add a scoped Talk-media capability
recommendation.body: Require an explicit manifest/runtime capability and enforce session ownership or a user-approved session grant before delivering PCM to a plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the proposed API and its subsequent scope refactor, so they are the best available routing contact for the contract discussion.
